headline: Distance to the nearest mast is the likely cause [distance_to_mast].
explanation: The nearest confirmed mast is 4.8 km away and belongs to O2 [nearest_site][operators_5km]. Vodafone's nearest site is farther, at 9.5 km, with a weak line-of-sight margin [los_vodafone]. O2, EE and Three all have clear lines of sight to nearer sites [los_o2][los_ee][los_three][network_comparison], so distance alone is not a strong blocker. No Ookla speed tests exist within 1 km, in this cell, or in any neighbouring cell in 2026Q3, so actual signal quality at the point cannot be measured [speed_1km][speed_cell][speed_neighbours].

rule_based.label: Based on data, not yet reviewed by agents
rule_based.rule: Operators ranked by line of sight from this point to their nearest identified site (clear, then marginal, then blocked); clear lines by distance, obstructed ones by how far the ground rises above the line.
rule_based.text: Likely best network here: O2, with a clear line of sight to a site 4.8 km west (confirmed by Ofcom's licence register). Also a clear line: EE (5.6 km) and Three (5.6 km).

limitations: Sites are approximate; antenna heights assumed; Ofcom figures are area-level.
Causes are inferred from public data, not confirmed: operators' network data is not public.
Ookla speeds are quarterly aggregates with no time-of-day detail; congestion can only be inferred.
No address-level Ofcom coverage; Ofcom figures are for the whole constituency and are predictions.
Mast sites are approximate (crowd-sourced OpenCelliD, OpenStreetMap, Ofcom's licence register) and incomplete, so 'no sites found' is weak evidence.
Line of sight uses a surface model (trees and buildings included) and mostly assumed antenna heights; blocked means a weaker signal, not no signal.

critiques.reason: The evidence shows clear line of sight for O2 (4.8 km), EE (5.6 km) and Three (5.6 km) [los_o2][los_ee][los_three][network_comparison], so distance alone is not a strong blocker. The belief correctly reflects this and its confidence is reasonable given the nearest mast is 4.8 km away and only O2 has sites within 5 km [nearest_site][operators_5km], while Vodafone is 9.5 km with a weak margin [los_vodafone].

No Ookla speed tests exist within 1 km, in this cell, or in any neighbouring cell in 2026Q3 [speed_1km][speed_cell][speed_neighbours], so actual signal quality at the point cannot be measured. The confidence reflects the weak evidence base [speed_1km][speed_cell][speed_neighbours].
